messages.subject: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hi,

I rented a plate compactor from you earlier this year and I'd like to book the same one again if possible. Can you check availability?

Thanks,
Jari Peltoniemi

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hi Jari,

Thanks for getting in touch. I'll check what we have and get back to you.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
One more thing - I'm also thinking about renting a cement mixer trailer. Do you deliver to Oulu or do I need to collect it myself?

Jari

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hi Jari,

Got your message about the cement mixer trailer. I'll look into the delivery options and let you know.

Jussi Kärnä
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor rental
messages.body:
Hello,

I've been charged for damage on my last rental and I don't think it's right. Your policy says small cosmetic damage is never chargeable - you only charge if the damage actually prevents the machine from working. The compactor had a few surface scratches, nothing that affects how it runs. I shouldn't be paying for that.

Please look into it.

Jari Peltoniemi
